## Week 10 May 26 - May 30, 2025

### Tasks Worked On
- Consolidated the code base with a major commit introducing most core modules:
  - Audio guidance components for speech-to-text processing.
  - Pydantic data contracts for AABB/OBB detection and segmentation.
  - Dataset loader and parser for StrayScanner recordings.
  - Initial scene-understanding pipeline and visualization utilities.
- Added experimental detection tests and an asynchronous pipeline prototype.

### Problems Encountered
- Combining many features at once made incremental testing difficult.
- Parsing orientation angles from Gemini outputs required ad-hoc heuristics.

### Plans for Next Week
- Create demonstration notebooks showing Gemini-based detection and segmentation.
- Begin evaluating approaches for 3‑D spatial understanding.
